title: Finance analyst - collection, finance
description:
About Voxy
Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.
Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.
We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you're on board, we would be happy to discuss.
You can find additional information about our values at this link (
The Impact You'll Have at Voxy
Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.
What You'll Be Doing:
Collections & Cash Application:
• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.
• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.
• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.
• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP& A Manager.
• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.
• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.
• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.
Credit Analysis & Risk Management:
• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.
• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.
Reporting & Analysis:
• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.
• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.
• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.
• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP& A Manager or Senior FP& A Analyst.
What We're Looking For:
• B. A/B. S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
• Based anywhere in Brazil
• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish
• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.
Job Details:
• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year
• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)
In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy:
• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)
• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events
• Remote friendly work policies
• Professional development budget
• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify
• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world
• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)
We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.
Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.
In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.
As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Finance analyst - collection, finance
description:
About Voxy
Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.
Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.
We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you're on board, we would be happy to discuss.
You can find additional information about our values at this link (
The Impact You'll Have at Voxy
Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.
What You'll Be Doing:
Collections & Cash Application:
• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.
• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.
• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.
• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP& A Manager.
• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.
• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.
• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.
Credit Analysis & Risk Management:
• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.
• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.
Reporting & Analysis:
• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.
• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.
• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.
• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP& A Manager or Senior FP& A Analyst.
What We're Looking For:
• B. A/B. S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
• Based anywhere in Brazil
• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish
• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.

• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year
• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)

title: Desenvolvedor full stack sênior
description:
Somos o futuro da Gestão de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho!
SOBRE NÓS
A Vixting está revolucionando a Admissão Digital e a Gestão Ocupacional no Brasil!
Com tecnologia de ponta, oferecemos soluções práticas e inteligentes que simplificam a rotina dos nossos clientes. Aqui, nosso foco vai além de serviços: acreditamos nas pessoas e na força de conexões baseadas em confiança, ética e paixão pelo que fazemos.
Acreditamos que cada pessoa tem um valor único e que o alinhamento cultural é o alicerce para relações duradouras e impactantes. Aqui, construímos conexões baseadas em confiança, ética e paixão por superar expectativas
Criamos soluções estratégicas
Somos apaixonados pelo maior ativo de uma companhia: Pessoas! Prezamos a essência de cada ser humano, buscamos o fit cultural para ser a base da nossa relação. Construímos relacionamentos baseados em confiança, caráter, honestidade, ética e paixão por encantar!
DESENVOLVEDOR FULLSTACK SÊNIOR
Responsabilidades e Atribuições
Core Técnico: Experiência sólida e comprovada em Node.js, React.js, Type Script e Java Script;
Cloud & Serverless: Vivência prática em ambiente AWS, com foco em arquitetura Serverless e AWS Lambda;
Mensageria: Experiência com sistemas de filas (especialmente AWS SQS);
Banco de Dados: Proficiência em My SQL e Mongo DB;
Dev Ops: Experiência na configuração de fluxos de CI/CD com Git Hub Actions;
Arquitetura: Conhecimento em quebra de monolitos e transição para microsserviços/serverless;
Produtividade: Utilização de ferramentas de IA no fluxo de trabalho diário para ganho de performance. Diferenciais (Serão considerados um grande peso)
Conhecimento em Dynamo DB (banco chave-valor).
Background no setor de Healthtech (especialmente medicina ocupacional).
Experiência prévia em empresas de software para RH, Recrutamento ou Onboarding. Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto
Nossos Benefícios
Vale refeição de R$36,00 por dia, sendo 22 dias úteis fixos;
Auxilio creche para mamãe ou papai;
Plano de saúde Alice sem mensalidade;
Plano odontológico Amil;
Wellhub;
Seguro de vida;
Day off.

description:

*****Job location Brazil (Remote)

Company Description
Bucksense, Inc. is the programmatic platform for advertisers and agencies looking to bring brand building in-house. Remote working.

Career growth in a constant learning environment.

We're looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.
What you'll do:
● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what's hot, what's not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.
● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.
● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.
● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.
We're looking for someone who is:
● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the "why" behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.
● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.
● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.
Bonus if you have:
● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.
● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).
● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.
What You'll Get
Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team
● Early access to product features and training sessions
● Workshops on social media, product, or design
Rewards & Credit System
We'll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!
Redeem credits for:
● Annual Meitu products membership
● " Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador" Certificate + internship reference
● Meitu Special Deisgn
● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership
● Summer Internship Offer
● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)
About Meitu
Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.
Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357. HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.
At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Tech lead .net - modernização
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Líder Técnico. NET para atuar à frente das squads responsáveis pela modernização e evolução de sistemas corporativos. Essa posição terá como missão liderar tecnicamente times multidisciplinares na transformação de aplicações legadas em soluções modernas, escaláveis e orientadas a domínio.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Definir e validar arquiteturas de sistemas baseados em. NET.
Orientar tecnicamente o time, promovendo boas práticas de desenvolvimento e padrões de código.
Realizar revisões de código e assegurar a qualidade das entregas.
Conduzir reuniões técnicas e apoiar na estimativa de esforço e planejamento.
Introduzir novas tecnologias e ferramentas que agreguem valor ao produto.
Garantir processos de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD).
Monitorar performance das aplicações e propor melhorias contínuas.
Atuar como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em soluções viáveis.
Mentorar desenvolvedores, promovendo crescimento técnico e profissional.
Realizar code review e fomentar boas práticas de codificação Requisitos e qualificações
Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com C#, ASP. NET Core, Entity Framework, APIs REST.
Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços e padrões de design.
Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
Vivência em plataformas de nuvem (Azure ou AWS).
Experiência com CI/CD, Git e práticas de Dev Ops.
Habilidade em liderança de equipes técnicas e gestão de projetos.
Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação com stakeholders.
Desejável conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas. Informações Adicionais

title: Analista de marketing digital
description:
Localização: Remoto
Tipo de contratação: Tempo integral
Sobre a oportunidade
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Marketing Digital para apoiar a execução e o acompanhamento de iniciativas de marketing em canais digitais.
Esta posição é indicada para profissionais que possuem familiaridade com rotinas de marketing digital e desejam atuar em um ambiente estruturado, com foco em organização, consistência e acompanhamento de resultados. O objetivo é contribuir para a execução adequada das campanhas e suporte às atividades do dia a dia.
Responsabilidades
Apoiar a execução de campanhas de marketing digital em diferentes canais.
Acompanhar métricas de desempenho e organizar informações relacionadas às campanhas.
Auxiliar na análise de dados para identificação de oportunidades de melhoria.
Contribuir com a preparação de relatórios e acompanhamento de resultados.
Apoiar a organização de atividades e fluxos de trabalho.
Colaborar com a equipe para garantir a execução consistente das iniciativas.
Seguir processos internos e manter a organização das atividades.
Requisitos
Experiência ou conhecimento em marketing digital.
Familiaridade com canais digitais e campanhas online.
Boa organização e atenção aos detalhes.
Perfil analítico e interesse em acompanhamento de métricas.
Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho em equipe.
Ambiente de trabalho
Modelo remoto.
Processos estruturados com suporte interno.
Ambiente colaborativo e profissional.

title: Gerente de marketing digital
description:
Estamos buscando candidatos para uma vaga em Marketing Digital em um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com muitas oportunidades de crescimento. Você será responsável por criar e implementar campanhas de marketing em plataformas digitais como Facebook, Google, Tik Tok e outros canais de mídia. O trabalho inclui planejamento de conteúdo, gestão de anúncios, monitoramento do desempenho das campanhas e otimização de custos para atingir os objetivos de negócios.
Os candidatos ideais devem ser criativos, proativos e possuir fortes habilidades em análise de dados. Experiência em marketing digital é uma vantagem, mas também damos as boas-vindas a jovens apaixonados e com vontade de aprender. É necessário ter excelentes habilidades de redação de conteúdo, conhecimento básico de SEO, publicidade online e ferramentas de marketing.
Oferecemos salário competitivo, bônus por desempenho e oportunidades claras de crescimento na carreira. Além disso, você receberá treinamento de desenvolvimento profissional e trabalhará em uma equipe amigável e colaborativa. Se você ama marketing e deseja construir uma carreira sólida, candidate-se hoje mesmo.

title: Technical implementation specialist
description:
Why Kodif?
At Kodif, we're transforming how customers interact with e Commerce brands. From shopping to support to retention, we're building agentic AI systems that make every website interaction personalized, instant, and human-like — redefining the modern customer journey.
Highlights:
Our team comes from Uber, Meta, Stanford, and Walmart. Our CTO built Uber's customer support platform.
We're backed by Bling Capital, SNR (Kevin Mahaffey), and Village Global (backed by Jeff Bezos, Bill Gates, and Reid Hoffman), with $9 M raised to date.
We're trusted by leading e Commerce brands like Dollar Shave Club, Liquid I. V., Trust Wallet, and Alma. Our Culture & Values:
At Kodif, our values guide how we work, what we build, and how we grow together:
Make It Simple – Build systems that are clear, reliable, and scalable.
Superhuman Speed ️ – Move fast and own the outcome — design, build, and deploy in days, not weeks.
Extreme Ownership – Take end-to-end responsibility for delivering impact, not just features.
Customer Crazy – We obsess over creating delightful, human-like AI experiences for our customers.
Two Steps Ahead – Anticipate issues before they surface. Design for the future.
Row Together – Collaborate, communicate, and ship together — success at Kodif is a team sport. Position Overview:
The Technical Implementation Specialist focuses on implementation of AI automation workflows, technical troubleshooting, product behavior analysis, and technical issue resolution. This role combines proactive customer management with technical troubleshooting, enabling Kodif's customers to maximize the value of our platform.
The Implementation Specialist will work cross-functionally to resolve issues, identify risks, and help customers succeed with the Kodif platform.
Responsibilities:
Partner with customers to align product adoption strategies with business goals.
Monitor customer communication channels to identify issues, resolve them, and escalate to Tier 2 technical support when needed.
Identify and mitigate risks related to usage, adoption, or critical defects by creating and executing targeted action plans.
Initiate and manage escalation processes, coordinating communication between customers and internal teams.
Support post-mortem analyses for escalations or major incidents.
Relay customer feedback to product and engineering to influence roadmap priorities.
Address concerns early to reduce churn risk and support long-term retention.
Support internal teams with technical insights and root-cause analysis.
Contribute to documentation, troubleshooting guides, and product improvements. Requirements:
Experience in Support, Implementation, or Customer Success (preferably in AI or CX Saa S).
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills (no coding required).
Strong technical acumen and ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of building trust and advocating for customers.
Experience with ticketing systems, Slack-based support, or similar communication tools.
Experience with LLM prompting.
Ability to read and interpret JSON (e.g., identify failed integration calls and relevant fields). Nice to have:
Ability to interpret SQL-level data and database-driven summaries (light query writing may be required).
Ability to read Python-related error messages and escalate appropriately (no direct coding required). Compensation & Benefits:
Competitive salary based on location and work experience.
Opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, product, and customer experience with real business impact.
Opportunity to build one of the most impactful AI systems in e Commerce. To be considered, please complete this short application form (2–3 minutes): YYr6 UDG4m RB9 SMt9 and then apply here as well.

title: Senior ruby on rails engineer
description:
About Stay FiStay Fi combines Io T and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable Wi Fi guest network with a custom-branded Wi Fi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.
Over the past 8 years, we've built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we're growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We're a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we're creating tools that our customers truly love. About You
You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
You're curious about Io T, Wi Fi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight. About the Role
Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, Postgre SQL, Tailwind CSS, React and Java Script, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.
Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team. Why Work at Stay Fi?
You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Accounting manager
description:
This role is for the person who:
Wants to help founders of e Commerce brands scale with confidence through clean, reliable financials.
Enjoys leading talented accountants and delivering clarity and insights founders can rely on.
Thrives in a tech-forward, growing environment where continuous improvement is encouraged. The salary range for this role is CA$ $ 3000–6000 p/m, depending on location and experience.
To support our continued growth, this is an active position we're currently recruiting for.
About Up Counting
We're a fully remote, tech-powered firm helping e Commerce and digital-first businesses scale with confidence.
Our global team works asynchronously, giving everyone time for deep, meaningful focus.
We use smart systems and automation to deliver high-quality, efficient work across every department.
We prioritize a respectful, collaborative environment where people feel supported and have space for life outside of work.
We trust our team to lead with ownership and care — autonomy is part of our DNA.
What You'll Be Doing
Team Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of Accountants to deliver accurate, timely, high-quality work.
Full-Cycle Accounting Oversight: Review reconciliations, financial reports, and month-end close deliverables across multiple client files.
Operational Excellence: Ensure Up Counting's accounting processes are followed consistently and improve them where needed.
Client Support & Communication: Help clients understand their numbers, communicate insights clearly, and ensure smooth financial operations.
System & Process Optimization: Identify automation opportunities and contribute to scalable, efficient workflows alongside Controllers and senior leadership.
What You Bring
5+ years of experience in accounting management, ideally within a firm or multi-client environment.
High proficiency in Quick Books Online and/or Xero (Net Suite is a bonus).
Excellent communication and leadership skills — you elevate the people around you.
Strong technical foundation across full-cycle accounting, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
Comfortable using automation tools and improving processes.
FP& A or financial modeling experience is an asset.
A calm, structured leadership style — you bring clarity without micromanagement.
Perks & Culture
Because great work deserves a great place to do it.
Fully Remote + Async
Work flexibly from anywhere. During your first six months, you'll align closely with EST hours (9am–5pm) to onboard smoothly, then transition to 70% overlap.
Work from Anywhere
We care about outcomes, not location.
Paid Time Off
Enjoy paid time off, Me Days, Stat Holidays in your region, and our year-end company office closure.
Grow With Us
We promote from within based on performance, leadership, reliability, and impact.
Continuous Learning
We invest in your development through certifications, internal training, and ongoing learning.
Fair and Market-Aligned Compensation
Competitive pay matched to your experience and local market.
Your Journey at Up Counting
Your First Week
Meet the People Team and Accounting leadership, onboard into our systems, connect with your direct reports, and understand our workflows across tools, teams, and time zones.
Month 1
You'll be managing client files, team rhythms, and weekly deliverables. You'll be leading your team through core processes, learning the review system end-to-end, and begin shaping how we operate.
In 3 Months
You'll fully own your portfolio of accountants and clients—setting priorities, supporting performance, ensuring high-quality delivery, and improving workflows. You'll be a go-to leader with autonomy and clarity.
Curious About Our Values & Culture?
They're built around excellence, autonomy, respect, and curiosity. Learn more on our Careers Page.
How We Hire
Our process is transparent, straightforward, and human:
Apply via Typeform: Short questions + a brief video.
Introductory Call: A short conversation with our People Team to align expectations.
Scenario-Based Assessment + Technical Review: A strategic exercise reviewed by our senior finance team.
Final Interview: A culture and alignment conversation with leadership.
Offer: If it's a mutual fit, we move quickly — great partnerships shouldn't wait.
No cover letter needed, just tell us what drew you to Up Counting. Every application is reviewed by our People team — we don't use AI to screen or assess candidates. Thoughtful hiring matters to us.

title: Senior digital analytics engineer
description:
Company Description
In 1995, Acronym created a digital marketing revolution by innovating a futuristic model of the marketing agency. Since then, we've forged a lasting path of success helping our Clients achieve their business goals.
Acronym. Our name signifies our deep understanding of both our Clients' and industries lexicon. For our Clients, it means an independent performance marketing agency with the flexibility to find solutions for any need, turning insights into action and action into results. We are headquartered in the iconic Empire State Building, with a presence across EMEA and APAC.
Role Description
The Remote Senior Digital Analytics Engineer will join our Analytics & Optimization team. This team member will be instrumental in implementing and maintaining sophisticated digital analytics solutions for our clients, ensuring a robust data foundation that drives strategic business decisions. You will leverage your deep technical expertise and understanding of business objectives to guide clients on best practices and implement cutting-edge tracking strategies. Some of the solutions this team member will be working with on a regular basis include Adobe Launch, Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Tealium i Q.

· Providing strategic guidance on data collection architecture and implementation strategies for web, app, and marketing technology solutions, acting as a technical leader on client engagements.

· Providing Quality Assurance (QA) of technical stakeholder deployments while thinking ahead on how to build solutions that solve common problems increasing efficiencies and improving data quality.
· Implementing and maintaining server-side tracking solutions to enhance data accuracy, improve user privacy, and overcome browser limitations.
· Integrating analytics platforms with other marketing and business systems (e.g., CRM, advertising platforms) using APIs to create a unified view of customer data.
· Optimizing analytics implementations for website and application performance to ensure tracking does not negatively impact user experience.
This is you...

Tag Management Systems include Adobe Launch, Tealium i Q, and Google Tag Manager.
· Four or more years of strong foundational Java Script experience, with the ability to read, write, and adapt to various coding styles, adapting to client's existing codebases.

· A solid understanding of and experience implementing solutions with user privacy in mind, including consent management frameworks and data minimization principles.
· Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, quantitative, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to approach technical challenges strategically in the context of data architecture and scalability.
· Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Remote position - USA

We're looking for a seasoned Chief Revenue Officer to help our client — an AI-powered logistics Saa S company — build and scale their US enterprise revenue engine from the ground up.
Our client is a Houston-based, seed-funded logistics platform founded in 2019. They bring consumer-app simplicity to enterprise logistics, unifying appointment scheduling, dock and yard management, and gate digitization for shippers, 3 PLs, and carriers.
They've built real product-market traction and are now ready to scale. That's where you come in.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own the entire US enterprise revenue motion end-to-end — strategy, hiring, pipeline, forecasting, and expansion. Build and execute the US enterprise GTM strategy from scratch
Hire, onboard, and lead the full revenue organization — AEs, BDRs, and sales management
Personally carry and close strategic early enterprise deals while the team ramps
Own pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue operations
Partner with the CEO on pricing, packaging, and market positioning
Establish the sales culture, process, and playbook for a company scaling from near-zero to multi-million in ARR What We're Looking For
Required:

Demonstrated track record scaling revenue from near-zero to multi-million within US enterprise
Proven experience hiring, building, and leading revenue teams (AEs, BDRs, sales managers) — not a solo operator with a CRO title
Deep logistics or supply chain industry experience
Native-level English and executive-level presence

Have reference-able revenue numbers you can point to from prior companies

title: Gestor de tráfego pago
description:
A Dropservice é a base por trás do crescimento de um ecossistema de marcas. Conectamos pessoas, processos e dados para que nossas marcas cresçam com clareza, eficiência e impacto nos maiores marketplaces do mundo.
Estamos em busca de um(a) Gestor(a) de Tráfego. Não é necessário ter experiência com Amazon. Procuramos alguém altamente capacitado(a) em tráfego pago (Google, Meta e outras plataformas), com mentalidade orientada a performance e disposição para dar o próximo passo na carreira dominando o Amazon Ads por dentro.
Se você é comunicativo(a), proativo(a), curioso(a), apaixonado(a) por aprendizado contínuo e não espera as oportunidades chegarem até você, queremos conversar com você.
Etapa obrigatória do processo
ANTES de finalizar sua candidatura pelo Linked In, preencha o formulário abaixo. Ele é obrigatório para que seu perfil seja considerado no processo seletivo e nos permite conduzir a análise com mais agilidade, clareza e transparência.
Acesse aqui: F7 SRd Us Kqns HD6
(Caso o link não apareça clicável, copie e cole o endereço diretamente no seu navegador.)
Importante: candidaturas sem o formulário preenchido não serão consideradas para análise.
O que você vai fazer
Aprender e atuar com Amazon Ads, com suporte e treinamento interno — vamos te ensinar o jeito Amazon de fazer.
Gerenciar e otimizar campanhas de tráfego pago.
Criar, testar e refinar estratégias de segmentação, criativos e estruturas de campanha com foco em ROAS, CPA e lucratividade. Oportunidade de crescimento
Você terá contato direto com sócios e liderança, compreendendo a estratégia do negócio além do gerenciador de anúncios.
Terá espaço para testar ideias, propor melhorias e acompanhar o impacto direto das suas campanhas em vendas reais.
Vai se desenvolver em Amazon Ads, um dos canais que mais cresce no Brasil e no mundo.
Ambiente com cultura forte de aprendizado contínuo, feedback direto e crescimento baseado em resultados — não em tempo de casa. Perfil ideal
Atua como gestor(a) de tráfego ou analista de mídia paga.
Tem mentalidade de performance, não apenas de execução.
É comunicativo(a), proativo(a) e trabalha bem de forma autônoma.
Gosta de aprender e se manter atualizado(a); faz anotações com frequência e quer crescer como profissional de performance. Experiência com Amazon Ads não é obrigatória — vamos te ensinar tudo sobre a plataforma. O que esperamos é uma base sólida em tráfego pago e muita vontade de aprender.
Requisitos obrigatórios
Experiência prática com tráfego pago (Google Ads, Meta Ads ou similar).
Capacidade de analisar métricas e tomar decisões orientadas por dados.
Boa comunicação escrita e verbal.
Organização para registrar testes, alterações e resultados.
Disponibilidade para atuar como PJ, em regime 100% remoto, em período integral. Diferenciais
Experiência com e-commerce, lançamentos ou vendas online.
Histórico de atuação em ambientes com metas de resultado (ROAS, CPA, faturamento ou lucro).
Qualquer experiência prévia com Amazon Ads será considerada um diferencial, ainda que não seja obrigatória. Como será o processo seletivo
Preenchimento do forms – ANTES de finalizar a candidatura no Linked In.
Análise do forms + triagem de currículo.
Aplicação do teste DISC.
Entrevista por vídeo com o time.
Feedback final (aprovado ou não) após a entrevista. Modelo de trabalho
Contratação: PJ – responsabilidade nas entregas e resultados, não nas horas.
Local: 100% remoto.
Faixa salarial: R$ 2.000,00 a R$ 3.000,00 (PJ) – de acordo com experiência e nível técnico.

title: Accounting manager
description:
This role is for the person who:
Wants to help founders of e Commerce brands scale with confidence through clean, reliable financials.
Enjoys leading talented accountants and delivering clarity and insights founders can rely on.
Thrives in a tech-forward, growing environment where continuous improvement is encouraged. The salary range for this role is CA$ $ 3000–6000 p/m, depending on location and experience.
To support our continued growth, this is an active position we're currently recruiting for.
About Up Counting
We're a fully remote, tech-powered firm helping e Commerce and digital-first businesses scale with confidence.
Our global team works asynchronously, giving everyone time for deep, meaningful focus.
We use smart systems and automation to deliver high-quality, efficient work across every department.
We prioritize a respectful, collaborative environment where people feel supported and have space for life outside of work.
We trust our team to lead with ownership and care — autonomy is part of our DNA.
What You'll Be Doing
Team Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of Accountants to deliver accurate, timely, high-quality work.
Full-Cycle Accounting Oversight: Review reconciliations, financial reports, and month-end close deliverables across multiple client files.
Operational Excellence: Ensure Up Counting's accounting processes are followed consistently and improve them where needed.
Client Support & Communication: Help clients understand their numbers, communicate insights clearly, and ensure smooth financial operations.
System & Process Optimization: Identify automation opportunities and contribute to scalable, efficient workflows alongside Controllers and senior leadership.
What You Bring
5+ years of experience in accounting management, ideally within a firm or multi-client environment.
High proficiency in Quick Books Online and/or Xero (Net Suite is a bonus).
Excellent communication and leadership skills — you elevate the people around you.
Strong technical foundation across full-cycle accounting, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
Comfortable using automation tools and improving processes.
FP& A or financial modeling experience is an asset.
A calm, structured leadership style — you bring clarity without micromanagement.
Perks & Culture
Because great work deserves a great place to do it.
Fully Remote + Async
Work flexibly from anywhere. During your first six months, you'll align closely with EST hours (9am–5pm) to onboard smoothly, then transition to 70% overlap.
Work from Anywhere
We care about outcomes, not location.
Paid Time Off
Enjoy paid time off, Me Days, Stat Holidays in your region, and our year-end company office closure.
Grow With Us
We promote from within based on performance, leadership, reliability, and impact.
Continuous Learning
We invest in your development through certifications, internal training, and ongoing learning.
Fair and Market-Aligned Compensation
Competitive pay matched to your experience and local market.
Your Journey at Up Counting
Your First Week
Meet the People Team and Accounting leadership, onboard into our systems, connect with your direct reports, and understand our workflows across tools, teams, and time zones.
Month 1
You'll be managing client files, team rhythms, and weekly deliverables. You'll be leading your team through core processes, learning the review system end-to-end, and begin shaping how we operate.
In 3 Months
You'll fully own your portfolio of accountants and clients—setting priorities, supporting performance, ensuring high-quality delivery, and improving workflows. You'll be a go-to leader with autonomy and clarity.
Curious About Our Values & Culture?
They're built around excellence, autonomy, respect, and curiosity. Learn more on our Careers Page.
How We Hire
Our process is transparent, straightforward, and human:
Apply via Typeform: Short questions + a brief video.
Introductory Call: A short conversation with our People Team to align expectations.
Scenario-Based Assessment + Technical Review: A strategic exercise reviewed by our senior finance team.
Final Interview: A culture and alignment conversation with leadership.
Offer: If it's a mutual fit, we move quickly — great partnerships shouldn't wait.
No cover letter needed, just tell us what drew you to Up Counting. Every application is reviewed by our People team — we don't use AI to screen or assess candidates. Thoughtful hiring matters to us.

title: Senior ruby on rails engineer
description:
About Stay FiStay Fi combines Io T and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable Wi Fi guest network with a custom-branded Wi Fi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.
Over the past 8 years, we've built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we're growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We're a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we're creating tools that our customers truly love. About You
You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
You're curious about Io T, Wi Fi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight. About the Role
Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, Postgre SQL, Tailwind CSS, React and Java Script, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.
Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team. Why Work at Stay Fi?
You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Analista de governança de dados sênior
description:
Você acredita que dados de qualidade são o alicerce para uma IA de sucesso? Sabe que governança não é burocracia, mas sim eficiência e confiança?
Na redspark, estamos em busca de um perfil sênior para transformar nossos instrumentos de governança em ferramentas vivas. Sua missão será garantir a integridade, a padronização e a rastreabilidade das informações que alimentam nossas maiores inovações.
Seu papel no time:
Operacionalizar o Catálogo e Metadados: Implementar e gerir o catálogo para que datasets críticos sejam facilmente encontrados e compreendidos.
Gestão do Glossário: Ser a ponte que padroniza os termos de negócio entre diferentes sistemas.
Data Quality na veia: Implementar regras de qualidade, monitorar métricas e apoiar o tratamento de inconsistências.
Mestria em Dados (MDM): Apoiar a estruturação de fontes autoritativas e dados mestres.
Linhagem e Transparência: Garantir a documentação e a rastreabilidade total da informação (da origem ao consumo).
Guardião da Padronização: Auxiliar na organização de datasets prontos para Analytics e IA. O que você traz na bagagem (Requisitos):
Sólida experiência em Catalogação de Dados, gestão de metadados e glossários.

title: Chief revenue officer
description:
Chief Revenue Officer
The Opportunity
We're looking for a seasoned Chief Revenue Officer to help our client — an AI-powered logistics Saa S company — build and scale their US enterprise revenue engine from the ground up.
Our client is a Houston-based, seed-funded logistics platform founded in 2019. They bring consumer-app simplicity to enterprise logistics, unifying appointment scheduling, dock and yard management, and gate digitization for shippers, 3 PLs, and carriers.
They've built real product-market traction and are now ready to scale. That's where you come in.
The Role
Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own the entire US enterprise revenue motion end-to-end — strategy, hiring, pipeline, forecasting, and expansion. This is a rare \"own the whole thing\" seat: you'll set GTM strategy, build the team, and personally drive early pipeline until that team is in place.
What You'll Do
Build and execute the US enterprise GTM strategy from scratch
Hire, onboard, and lead the full revenue organization — AEs, BDRs, and sales management
Personally carry and close strategic early enterprise deals while the team ramps
Own pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue operations
Partner with the CEO on pricing, packaging, and market positioning
Establish the sales culture, process, and playbook for a company scaling from near-zero to multi-million in ARR What We're Looking For
Required:
15–20 years of revenue leadership experience at the CRO level
Demonstrated track record scaling revenue from near-zero to multi-million within US enterprise
Proven experience hiring, building, and leading revenue teams (AEs, BDRs, sales managers) — not a solo operator with a CRO title
Deep logistics or supply chain industry experience
Native-level English and executive-level presence
Willingness to provide 2–3 references from prior employers You'll thrive in this role if you:
Have reference-able revenue numbers you can point to from prior companies
Are energized by building from scratch rather than managing a mature org
Can toggle fluidly between strategy, recruiting, and rolling up your sleeves to close deals
Have operated inside or sold into US enterprise logistics, freight, or supply chain This is not the right fit if you:
Come from a mid-market or non-logistics Saa S background
Have primarily tactical experience (AE, sales manager) without true org leadership
Lead with CRM/pipeline theater rather than produced revenue
Have never built or managed a revenue team

title: Business development representative
description:
We Master Trade is a rapidly scaling fintech company operating in the trading space, connecting traders, partners, and affiliates across global markets. We move fast, think big, and focus on results. Our mission is to build a powerful ecosystem of strategic partnerships that drive growth and create long-term value. We are seeking a strategic and relationship-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing team. In this role, you will focus on identifying, developing, and managing high-value partnerships that drive sustainable growth. You will play a key role in expanding our network of partners, affiliates, and strategic collaborators across global markets.
Responsibilities:
• Identify and engage potential strategic partners, affiliates, and business opportunities aligned with our growth objectives.
• Develop and nurture long-term relationships with partners, acting as a trusted point of contact.
• Evaluate partnership opportunities and build proposals that align with mutual business goals.
• Collaborate with internal teams (sales, marketing, operations) to execute and optimize partnership strategies.
• Support onboarding of new partners, ensuring a smooth and successful integration into our platform.
• Monitor partner performance and identify opportunities to maximize value and revenue.
• Maintain accurate records of partnerships, communications, and pipeline activity in CRM systems.
• Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities to support expansion strategies.
Qualifications:
• 1–3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or account management roles.
• Strong communication skills in English (professional level).
• Strategic mindset with strong relationship-building and negotiation skills.
• Ability to manage multiple partnerships and priorities simultaneously.
• Experience using CRM tools (e.g., Hub Spot, Salesforce).
• Analytical thinking with a focus on long-term growth and value creation.
• Experience in fintech, trading, brokerage, affiliate programs, or digital platforms is a strong advantage.
What We Offer:
• Opportunity to work on high-impact strategic initiatives
• Ongoing professional development and career growth
• Collaborative and international work environment
• Exposure to global markets and partnership ecosystems
Job Type: Full-Time / Remote
Salary: $800 USD/month + Commission

title: Salesforce administrator
description:
Position Overview:
As a Salesforce Administrator, you will play a foundational role in building and scaling our CRM ecosystem. This position goes far beyond traditional administration—you will help architect a next‐generation CRM platform that supports rapid scaling, automation‐first operations, and AI‐driven decision‐making across the organization.
You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and our Contact Center leadership team to design intelligent workflows, optimize business processes, and create a flexible, automated CRM foundation.
Responsibilities:
Administers day‐to‐day Salesforce operations, including user access, permissions, security controls, page layouts, objects, record types, and data governance.
Builds scalable automation (primarily using Flows) to replace manual processes and improve operational efficiency across teams.
Partners with cross‐functional stakeholders to map business processes, identify gaps, and design technical solutions aligned with business requirements.
Translates business requirements into detailed user stories, functional specifications, and structured workflows.
Analyzes CRM usage patterns, funnel metrics, and customer service trends to recommend operational and process improvements.
Builds dashboards and reports that surface insights for leaders, including case trends, SLA performance, agent productivity, lifecycle metrics, and GTM funnel health.
Maintains documentation of data models, configurations, integrations, automations, and process maps.
Collaborates with stakeholders to build lead management flows, sales processes, customer lifecycle models, and AI‐powered workflow automations.
Designs, optimizes, and maintains Salesforce Service Cloud functionality supporting the Contact Center, including case management, omni‐channel routing, macros, and agent console configurations.
Partners with Contact Center leadership to analyze operational bottlenecks and design scalable workflows that reduce agent handle time and improve customer experience.
Supports and enhances CTI/telephony integrations and related automations, including screen pops, routing logic, call dispositions, and agent productivity tooling.
Ensures secure, least‐privilege access by owning the configuration and governance of profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchies aligned with Contact Center needs.
Identifies proactively opportunities to improve processes, workflows, routing, and system performance, particularly within the Contact Center environment.
Manages data imports and updates, including deduplication, cleansing initiatives, and data governance enforcement.
Supports integration efforts with core internal systems, marketing automation platforms, billing solutions, and internal tools.
Delivers training, onboarding, and ongoing support to drive strong user adoption across fast‐scaling teams.
Troubleshoots issues proactively and serves as the go‐to expert for Salesforce reliability, scalability, and performance. Position Requirements:
4 years of Salesforce Administration experience, ideally in an enterprise‐level or high‐velocity environment.
Salesforce certifications, such as Administrator or Advanced Administrator, are preferred.
Ability to work from our Austin-based headquarters, at least four days per week – excluding approved time off and business travel. Additional Requirements:
Strong expertise in Salesforce configuration, automation (Flows), data modeling, and security architecture.
Experience supporting Contact Center or Service Cloud environments, including agent workflows, case management, routing, or telephony integrations (preferred).
Proven ability in requirements gathering, process design, workflow mapping, and reporting/analytics.
Background supporting Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, or cross‐functional GTM operations.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn CRM data into insights and actionable recommendations.
Familiarity with integrations, connected apps, APIs, middleware, and data sync patterns (no coding required, but technical comfort is essential).
Hands‐on experience with lead routing, funnel analytics, lifecycle automation, or revenue operations tooling is highly valued.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a fast‐moving, high‐growth environment.

title: Firewall engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Firewall Engineer (L3 Support – F5 Technologies)
We are looking for a skilled Firewall Engineer to provide L3-level support from a nearshore location in Latin America, with a strong focus on F5 technologies. This role involves operational support, configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization of F5 devices and related security infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities
• Manage and support F5 BIG-IP platforms (LTM, GTM/DNS, ASM, APM as applicable)
• Perform L3 troubleshooting for application delivery, load balancing, and firewall-related issues
• Implement configuration changes, policy updates, and SSL certificate management
• Analyze traffic flows and security events to ensure optimal performance and protection
• Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis for F5-related issues
• Support automation or scripting tasks for configuration consistency (e.g., Python, i Control REST)
• Maintain documentation for configurations, standards, and operational procedures
• Collaborate with network and security teams to support enterprise-wide initiatives
Required Skills
• Strong hands-on experience with F5 BIG-IP modules
• Deep understanding of L4–L7 traffic flows, TCP/IP, and application delivery
• Ability to troubleshoot complex issues independently at an L3 level
• Experience working in remote/nearshore support models
If you're ready to take on complex challenges in a dynamic environment, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Salesforce crm specialist
description:
Position Overview:
As the Customer Relationship Management Specialist (CRM Specialist), you will support the day-to-day execution of the CRM function. You will be a key contributor in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), partnering with Marketing, Operations, Contact Center, and Product to build and optimize journeys, automations, and campaigns that move clients from inquiry to booked appointment to loyal advocate.
This role sits within the Marketing team, working alongside peers across demand generation, digital performance, brand, and content.
Key Responsibilities:
Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC):
Support the execution and optimization of campaigns within SFMC. Collaborate on building, testing, and deploying journeys and automations with a strong focus on the end-user experience and business impact.
Client Journey:
Assist in building and improving omnichannel journeys across email and SMS, supporting key moments from lead to booking to post-visit engagement, including reminders and follow-ups.
Data Segmentation and Hygiene:
Maintain audience segments and support data quality initiatives, including contact organization, suppression lists, and basic scoring logic to ensure a reliable database.
Testing & Quality Control:
Execute A/B tests on subject lines, send times, messaging, and journey logic. Document results and apply learnings to improve performance.
Performance & Reporting:
Support CRM reporting by tracking key metrics such as bookings, conversion rates, and engagement. Contribute to performance analysis and insights.
Operational Support:
Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Contact Center, and Product teams to identify and help resolve friction points in the client journey.
Platform Integrations:
Support the day-to-day functioning of SFMC in coordination with Salesforce CRM and other tools. Escalate issues and collaborate on solutions when needed.
Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
3–5 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation roles, including Salesforce Marketing Cloud
Ability to work on-site at the company's headquarters at least 4 days per week
Preferred Qualifications:
Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification
Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM
Experience in multi-location services, retail, or health and wellness industries
Familiarity with booking or practice management systems
Experience with SMS marketing and omnichannel engagement
Basic understanding of Martech integrations and data structures
Experience creating or adapting content to improve engagement across the client lifecycle

Liderar, mentorar e acelerar o desenvolvimento da equipe de programadores, criando uma cultura de alta performance e boas práticas.

description:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gestor(a) de Tráfego. Não é necessário ter experiência com Amazon. Procuramos alguém altamente capacitado(a) em tráfego pago (Google, Meta e outras plataformas), com mentalidade orientada a performance e disposição para dar o próximo passo na carreira dominando o Amazon Ads por dentro.
Se você é comunicativo(a), proativo(a), curioso(a), apaixonado(a) por aprendizado contínuo e não espera as oportunidades chegarem até você, queremos conversar com você.
Etapa obrigatória do processo
ANTES de finalizar sua candidatura pelo Linked In, preencha o formulário abaixo. Ele é obrigatório para que seu perfil seja considerado no processo seletivo e nos permite conduzir a análise com mais agilidade, clareza e transparência.

Aprender e atuar com Amazon Ads, com suporte e treinamento interno — vamos te ensinar o jeito Amazon de fazer.
Gerenciar e otimizar campanhas de tráfego pago.
Criar, testar e refinar estratégias de segmentação, criativos e estruturas de campanha com foco em ROAS, CPA e lucratividade. Oportunidade de crescimento

Terá espaço para testar ideias, propor melhorias e acompanhar o impacto direto das suas campanhas em vendas reais.
Vai se desenvolver em Amazon Ads, um dos canais que mais cresce no Brasil e no mundo.
Ambiente com cultura forte de aprendizado contínuo, feedback direto e crescimento baseado em resultados — não em tempo de casa. Perfil ideal
Atua como gestor(a) de tráfego ou analista de mídia paga.
Tem mentalidade de performance, não apenas de execução.
É comunicativo(a), proativo(a) e trabalha bem de forma autônoma.
Gosta de aprender e se manter atualizado(a); faz anotações com frequência e quer crescer como profissional de performance. Experiência com Amazon Ads não é obrigatória — vamos te ensinar tudo sobre a plataforma. O que esperamos é uma base sólida em tráfego pago e muita vontade de aprender.
Requisitos obrigatórios
Experiência prática com tráfego pago (Google Ads, Meta Ads ou similar).
Capacidade de analisar métricas e tomar decisões orientadas por dados.
Boa comunicação escrita e verbal.
Organização para registrar testes, alterações e resultados.
Disponibilidade para atuar como PJ, em regime 100% remoto, em período integral. Diferenciais
Experiência com e-commerce, lançamentos ou vendas online.
Histórico de atuação em ambientes com metas de resultado (ROAS, CPA, faturamento ou lucro).
Qualquer experiência prévia com Amazon Ads será considerada um diferencial, ainda que não seja obrigatória. Como será o processo seletivo
Preenchimento do forms – ANTES de finalizar a candidatura no Linked In.
Análise do forms + triagem de currículo.
Aplicação do teste DISC.
Entrevista por vídeo com o time.
Feedback final (aprovado ou não) após a entrevista. Modelo de trabalho
Contratação: PJ – responsabilidade nas entregas e resultados, não nas horas.
Local: 100% remoto.
Faixa salarial: R$ 2.000,00 a R$ 3.000,00 (PJ) – de acordo com experiência e nível técnico.

title: Accounting manager
description:
This role is for the person who:
Wants to help founders of e Commerce brands scale with confidence through clean, reliable financials.
Enjoys leading talented accountants and delivering clarity and insights founders can rely on.
Thrives in a tech-forward, growing environment where continuous improvement is encouraged. The salary range for this role is CA$ $ 3000–6000 p/m, depending on location and experience.
To support our continued growth, this is an active position we're currently recruiting for.
About Up Counting
We're a fully remote, tech-powered firm helping e Commerce and digital-first businesses scale with confidence.
Our global team works asynchronously, giving everyone time for deep, meaningful focus.
We use smart systems and automation to deliver high-quality, efficient work across every department.
We prioritize a respectful, collaborative environment where people feel supported and have space for life outside of work.
We trust our team to lead with ownership and care — autonomy is part of our DNA.
What You'll Be Doing
Team Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of Accountants to deliver accurate, timely, high-quality work.
Full-Cycle Accounting Oversight: Review reconciliations, financial reports, and month-end close deliverables across multiple client files.
Operational Excellence: Ensure Up Counting's accounting processes are followed consistently and improve them where needed.
Client Support & Communication: Help clients understand their numbers, communicate insights clearly, and ensure smooth financial operations.
System & Process Optimization: Identify automation opportunities and contribute to scalable, efficient workflows alongside Controllers and senior leadership.
What You Bring
5+ years of experience in accounting management, ideally within a firm or multi-client environment.
High proficiency in Quick Books Online and/or Xero (Net Suite is a bonus).
Excellent communication and leadership skills — you elevate the people around you.
Strong technical foundation across full-cycle accounting, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
Comfortable using automation tools and improving processes.
FP& A or financial modeling experience is an asset.
A calm, structured leadership style — you bring clarity without micromanagement.
Perks & Culture
Because great work deserves a great place to do it.
Fully Remote + Async
Work flexibly from anywhere. During your first six months, you'll align closely with EST hours (9am–5pm) to onboard smoothly, then transition to 70% overlap.
Work from Anywhere
We care about outcomes, not location.
Paid Time Off
Enjoy paid time off, Me Days, Stat Holidays in your region, and our year-end company office closure.
Grow With Us
We promote from within based on performance, leadership, reliability, and impact.
Continuous Learning
We invest in your development through certifications, internal training, and ongoing learning.
Fair and Market-Aligned Compensation
Competitive pay matched to your experience and local market.
Your Journey at Up Counting
Your First Week
Meet the People Team and Accounting leadership, onboard into our systems, connect with your direct reports, and understand our workflows across tools, teams, and time zones.
Month 1
You'll be managing client files, team rhythms, and weekly deliverables. You'll be leading your team through core processes, learning the review system end-to-end, and begin shaping how we operate.
In 3 Months
You'll fully own your portfolio of accountants and clients—setting priorities, supporting performance, ensuring high-quality delivery, and improving workflows. You'll be a go-to leader with autonomy and clarity.
Curious About Our Values & Culture?
They're built around excellence, autonomy, respect, and curiosity. Learn more on our Careers Page.
How We Hire
Our process is transparent, straightforward, and human:
Apply via Typeform: Short questions + a brief video.
Introductory Call: A short conversation with our People Team to align expectations.
Scenario-Based Assessment + Technical Review: A strategic exercise reviewed by our senior finance team.
Final Interview: A culture and alignment conversation with leadership.
Offer: If it's a mutual fit, we move quickly — great partnerships shouldn't wait.
No cover letter needed, just tell us what drew you to Up Counting. Every application is reviewed by our People team — we don't use AI to screen or assess candidates. Thoughtful hiring matters to us.

title: Analista de dados digitais (tracking & analytics)
description:
Sobre a THREAD
A THREAD é uma consultoria de tecnologia e engenharia de software que cresce de forma consistente, impulsionada pela entrega contínua de valor e pela confiança de grandes marcas.
Somos especialistas em desenvolver sistemas sob medida, conectando estratégia, dados e performance em cada solução.
Atuamos em parceria com empresas de diversos setores, entregando produtos digitais, integrações e plataformas que unem tecnologia à estratégia de negócio.
Descrição da vaga
Buscamos um Analista de Dados Digitais (Tracking & Analytics) para atuar 100% remoto, apoiando a estruturação, coleta e análise de dados em produtos digitais de clientes.
Você será responsável por garantir que os dados capturados reflitam corretamente o comportamento do usuário, apoiando decisões de produto, marketing e negócio.
Esperamos alguém organizado, analítico e com forte capacidade de execução, que consiga transformar necessidades de negócio em estruturas de tracking claras, confiáveis e escaláveis.
Responsabilidades
Estruturar e manter mapas de tags (tracking plan)
Realizar tagueamento via Google Tag Manager (GTM)
Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento na criação e validação de variáveis e eventos
Garantir a qualidade e consistência dos dados coletados
Criar e evoluir relatórios de acompanhamento no Looker Studio
Validar implementações de tracking (debug, testes e QA)
Trabalhar em conjunto com times técnicos e de produto para entender necessidades de mensuração
Documentar regras de tracking e estrutura de eventos
Identificar oportunidades de melhoria na coleta e uso de dados Requisitos Obrigatórios
Experiência com Google Tag Manager (GTM)
Experiência com Google Analytics (GA4)
Conhecimento em estruturação de tracking (eventos, variáveis, data Layer)
Experiência com Looker Studio (criação de dashboards)
Capacidade de estruturar mapas de mensuração (tracking plan)
Boa comunicação para interação com times técnicos (devs)
Perfil analítico e orientado a dados

title: Senior digital analytics engineer
description:
Company Description
In 1995, Acronym created a digital marketing revolution by innovating a futuristic model of the marketing agency. Since then, we've forged a lasting path of success helping our Clients achieve their business goals.
Acronym. Our name signifies our deep understanding of both our Clients' and industries lexicon. For our Clients, it means an independent performance marketing agency with the flexibility to find solutions for any need, turning insights into action and action into results. We are headquartered in the iconic Empire State Building, with a presence across EMEA and APAC.
Role Description
The Remote Senior Digital Analytics Engineer will join our Analytics & Optimization team. This team member will be instrumental in implementing and maintaining sophisticated digital analytics solutions for our clients, ensuring a robust data foundation that drives strategic business decisions. You will leverage your deep technical expertise and understanding of business objectives to guide clients on best practices and implement cutting-edge tracking strategies. This role will also have the opportunity to explore and implement emerging technologies, including AI-powered tools, to enhance data collection and efficiency over time. Some of the solutions this team member will be working with on a regular basis include Adobe Launch, Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Tealium i Q.
This is the job...
· Providing strategic guidance on data collection architecture and implementation strategies for web, app, and marketing technology solutions, acting as a technical leader on client engagements.
· Ensuring that all data collection and implementation efforts are aligned with client business objectives and contribute to the delivery of accurate and actionable insights that drive measurable results.
· Working directly with technical stakeholders to answer questions, and help troubleshoot issues.
· Creating technical documentation for our clients on how to best implement various web analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Adobe Analytics, as well as other marketing technologies.
· Expertly configuring tag management systems (e.g., Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, Tealium i Q), analytics platforms (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics) and various third-party tracking pixels (Meta, Linked In, etc) based on sound data collection principles and industry best practices, as part of a comprehensive data collection strategy.
· Providing Quality Assurance (QA) of technical stakeholder deployments while thinking ahead on how to build solutions that solve common problems increasing efficiencies and improving data quality.
· Implementing and maintaining server-side tracking solutions to enhance data accuracy, improve user privacy, and overcome browser limitations.
· Integrating analytics platforms with other marketing and business systems (e.g., CRM, advertising platforms) using APIs to create a unified view of customer data.
· Optimizing analytics implementations for website and application performance to ensure tracking does not negatively impact user experience.
This is you...
· Seven or more years of progressive experience in implementing and maintaining Digital Analytics and Tag Management Systems, with a strong preference for Adobe Analytics and experience with Adobe Customer Journey Analytics. Tag Management Systems include Adobe Launch, Tealium i Q, and Google Tag Manager.
· Four or more years of strong foundational Java Script experience, with the ability to read, write, and adapt to various coding styles, adapting to client's existing codebases.
· Proven experience in debugging analytics implementations using tools like Omnibug, Adobe Experience Cloud Debugger, Browser Stack, etc., and ideally experience with QA monitoring tools.
· A solid understanding of and experience implementing solutions with user privacy in mind, including consent management frameworks and data minimization principles.
· Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, quantitative, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to approach technical challenges strategically in the context of data architecture and scalability.
· Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Please, resume in English
Remote position - USA
Work hours: 9 Am to 5:30 PM NY time - 30 min break
Hiring type: Contractor PJ

description:

Na redspark, estamos em busca de um perfil sênior para transformar nossos instrumentos de governança em ferramentas vivas. Sua missão será garantir a integridade, a padronização e a rastreabilidade das informações que alimentam nossas maiores inovações.

Mestria em Dados (MDM): Apoiar a estruturação de fontes autoritativas e dados mestres.
Linhagem e Transparência: Garantir a documentação e a rastreabilidade total da informação (da origem ao consumo).
Guardião da Padronização: Auxiliar na organização de datasets prontos para Analytics e IA. O que você traz na bagagem (Requisitos):
Sólida experiência em Catalogação de Dados, gestão de metadados e glossários.
Domínio de processos de Data Quality (limpeza, padronização e monitoramento).
SQL Avançado para Data Profiling e análise de inconsistências.
Conhecimento profundo dos princípios do DAMA-DMBOK.
Excelente capacidade de documentação técnica para diferentes públicos. Diferenciais que valorizamos:
Experiência com ferramentas de mercado (Apache Atlas, CKAN, Purview ou similares).
Vivência em projetos com foco em LGPD e Privacy by Design.
Conhecimento em arquitetura Lakehouse ou modelagem semântica.
Inovação com IA: Interesse em usar IA Generativa para automatizar metadados e documentação.
Experiência com dados do setor público ou ambiental (CAR, SIGEF, INCRA) será um baita diferencial! Por que a redspark?
Se você busca um ambiente que valoriza a maturidade técnica, a autonomia e que entende que a Governança é a chave para o futuro da IA, seu lugar é aqui.
