title: Chief revenue officer
description:
Chief Revenue Officer
The Opportunity
We're looking for a seasoned Chief Revenue Officer to help our client — an AI-powered logistics Saa S company — build and scale their US enterprise revenue engine from the ground up.
Our client is a Houston-based, seed-funded logistics platform founded in 2019. They bring consumer-app simplicity to enterprise logistics, unifying appointment scheduling, dock and yard management, and gate digitization for shippers, 3 PLs, and carriers.
They've built real product-market traction and are now ready to scale. That's where you come in.
The Role
Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own the entire US enterprise revenue motion end-to-end — strategy, hiring, pipeline, forecasting, and expansion. This is a rare \"own the whole thing\" seat: you'll set GTM strategy, build the team, and personally drive early pipeline until that team is in place.
What You'll Do
Build and execute the US enterprise GTM strategy from scratch
Hire, onboard, and lead the full revenue organization — AEs, BDRs, and sales management
Personally carry and close strategic early enterprise deals while the team ramps
Own pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue operations
Partner with the CEO on pricing, packaging, and market positioning
Establish the sales culture, process, and playbook for a company scaling from near-zero to multi-million in ARR What We're Looking For
Required:
15–20 years of revenue leadership experience at the CRO level
Demonstrated track record scaling revenue from near-zero to multi-million within US enterprise
Proven experience hiring, building, and leading revenue teams (AEs, BDRs, sales managers) — not a solo operator with a CRO title
Deep logistics or supply chain industry experience
Native-level English and executive-level presence
Willingness to provide 2–3 references from prior employers You'll thrive in this role if you:
Have reference-able revenue numbers you can point to from prior companies
Are energized by building from scratch rather than managing a mature org
Can toggle fluidly between strategy, recruiting, and rolling up your sleeves to close deals
Have operated inside or sold into US enterprise logistics, freight, or supply chain This is not the right fit if you:
Come from a mid-market or non-logistics Saa S background
Have primarily tactical experience (AE, sales manager) without true org leadership
Lead with CRM/pipeline theater rather than produced revenue
Have never built or managed a revenue team

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia

Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.
WHAT IT TAKES
The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.
Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.
Be fully aligned with our core values:
Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Technical product owner
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.
Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.
Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.
WHAT IT TAKES
The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.
Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.
Be fully aligned with our core values:
Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

We are seeking an experienced Compensation Expert with strong expertise in Cornerstone On Demand (CSOD)
Serve as a course implementation expert to our primarily partners to help drive our course deployments
Understand and apply comprehensive learning operations knowledge to execute effective course deployment strategies to global audiences.
Strong and effective in written, verbal, and presentation skills
Analyze and provide recommendations to address existing problems.
Develops creative solutions in preparation for unforeseen issues.
Apply analytical and critical thinking skills quickly and accurately in a high-pressure situation
Detail-oriented, data-driven, and customer-focused professional who can pivot priorities based on changing business needs
Support our internal community by driving impact through collaborative working relationships
Be able to network with, and appropriately identify and involve key internal stakeholders to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings
Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and working within the context of a new team in the process of building out an operations program
Operate independently in fast moving, stressful situations while managing mission critical tasks
Anticipate needs before being asked, identify opportunities to improve processes and create efficiencies
Be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing workloads to meet competing deadlines
Provide clear and constant communication and escalate issues in a timely manner
Responsibilities:

Maintain project plan and complete operational processes and deliverables to help ensure effective, trouble-free e-Learn and in-person course launches to our targeted audiences
Actively and effectively partner with L&D Program Managers and SMEs to support new and ongoing course deployments
Document and provide course deployment requirements (e.g. reoccurrence) which informs the correct course configurations and assignment of course curriculums
Draft and maintain course playbooks, key deployment changes, course requirements, and other standard operating procedure documents
Track and report course key metrics and performance measures to key stakeholder as required
Drive course impact by leveraging data to implement best practices that increase enrollment, discoverability, and consumption of our learning content
Develop and document effective course communication escalation strategies to help drive compliance course completions
Provide oversight for e-Learning course maintenance, ILT event management, class session forecasting, group / target audience assignments, and learner enrollments for all assigned programs
Prepare and facilitate course quarterly business review meetings with stakeholders
Provide course learner support for assigned courses by resolving issues or routing cases to appropriate team members to resolve
Work with People Operations, Engineering (Eng), People Insights, and Data teams to root cause potential LMS, reporting, or learner support issues
Drive the execution of all learning related audit control testing and support any operational audit initiatives
Identify and communicate system and process issues to L&D and make recommendations on programs to drive operational efficiencies
NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.
Minimum Requirements:

Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.
Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Systems administrator, senior
description:
Newfold Digital empowers the world’s business owners, content publishers, and those with ideas to control their online destiny with power and confidence. We enable everyone to be able to establish their online presence. From buying a domain and setting up a website, to growing their business and presence online, we come together to make sure small businesses have all the tools and support they need to achieve their goals.
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Systems Administrator.
Key Responsibilities
Cloud & Infrastructure Management
Administer and optimize OCI or other cloud platforms (compute, storage, IAM, networking)
Automate deployments using Terraform, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines
Monitor and troubleshoot performance using Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, etc
System Operations
Perform system maintenance and patching on Linux/Unix platforms
Troubleshoot OS, hardware, and database (My SQL/Postgre SQL) issues
Automate routine tasks via Bash, Python, or Ruby scripts
Webhosting experience (c Panel, Exim, My SQL)
Windows Hosting experience (IIS, DNS , Mailenable)
Required Skills
5+ years of hands-on Systems Administration
Strong understanding of Linux/Windows servers, DNS, Web Servers,
Expertise in managing proxies (NGINX, HAProxy), DDo S mitigation
Scripting knowledge: Python, Bash, or Ruby
Proficiency with Ia C tools (Terraform), observability (Grafana, Prometheus)
Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS/SSL
Cloud experience with OCI or equivalent (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Preferred Experience
4+ years managing hybrid cloud infrastructure
Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Pages, or Load Balancing
Familiarity with CI/CD, Ansible, Puppet, or OCI CLI
Security/cloud certifications (OCI, AWS, Azure)
Why you'll love us
We offer a 100% remote position with a monthly home office allowance of R$180.00 and an additional allowance for purchasing items for your office.
We provide Meal Vouchers or Food Vouchers worth R$44.55 per working day.
Health and dental insurance with no co-payment for employees.
Well-being program: Wellhub and Telemedicine!
Do you have a dog, cat, rabbit, hamster, goat, turtle, or even a mini dragon? We have a partnership for pet health insurance!
Life insurance.
Free website hosting.
Merit and promotion annual cycle.
And muuuuuuch more!

title: Product owner
description:
Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success
Remote (Brazil-based) | Supporting UK & US stakeholders | 8,000 - 10,000 BRL
We’re proud to be partnering with an innovative, fast-growing Saa S business that is transforming how organisations deliver professional online auction experiences under their own brand. Following a period of impressive growth, our client is now looking to appoint a Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success to play a pivotal role in their next phase.
This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of product, clients, and operations —owning the journey from signed deal through to successful platform adoption.
The Opportunity
As Product Owner, you’ll take the lead in ensuring new clients are seamlessly onboarded and set up for success from day one. Working closely with senior leadership, engineering, and customer success, you’ll help clients quickly reach their first live auction and build long-term confidence using the platform.
This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role where you’ll:
Guide clients through onboarding and implementation
Translate real-world client needs into clear product requirements
Support ongoing customer success and operational excellence
Play a key role in product testing and continuous improvement
What You’ll Be Doing
Owning the end-to-end onboarding journey from sales handover to go-live Acting as a trusted partner to clients, supporting early use and best practice
Gathering and defining technical and operational requirements Collaborating with engineering to ensure smooth configuration and delivery
Testing new features and ensuring releases are client-ready
Feeding real client insight back into the product roadmap
What We’re Looking For
Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Saa S Implementation specialist A strong track record in customer success, onboarding, or client-facing roles Ability to translate client needs into structured product requirements
Comfortable working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams Highly organised, proactive, and confident managing multiple stakeholders
Exposure to B2 B Saa S, Agile environments, or platform-based products would be highly advantageous.
Why Apply?
Join a scaling, globally-focused Saa S business at an exciting stage of growth Work directly with an experienced and passionate leadership team
Have real influence over product direction and client success Fully remote role with international collaboration
Be instrumental in shaping how clients experience and succeed with the platform
If you’re a product-minded professional who thrives on solving real client problems and driving meaningful outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Engenheiro de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi
Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!
O desafio
Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.
Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.
Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.
O que você vai fazer: Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS; Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ; Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio; Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados; Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.
O que esperamos de você: Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev); Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção; Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM; Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C) ; Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia; Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero; Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.
Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.
Benefícios que oferecemos:
Modelo remoto prioritário
Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação
30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano
Day off no aniversário
Total Pass (incluindo Total Mind)
Acesso ao Wework
Encontros presenciais para troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule

description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.
Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.
Key Responsibilities
Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.

Requirements Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution. Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations. Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus. Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.

This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Na Ligia Academy, estamos buscando um/a Professor/a de Inglês
Hoje um de nossos projetos o Francês com a Ligia é hoje uma referência no ensino do idioma francês online no Brasil. Ela nasceu pequena, porém hoje, milhares de alunos já conseguiram realizar o sonho de falar francês.
E vem mais por ai!
Neste momento vivemos um momento incrível de expansão, no qual estamos ampliando nossa produção de conteúdo e de ensino do inglês, por isso estamos construindo uma nova equipe responsável por representar este novo momento.
O que faz um/a Professor/a de Inglês no Francês com a Ligia?
Baseado em nosso método de ensino (Método Francês com a Ligia) e tudo o que ele propõe, o candidato/a deverá:
Pesquisar e elaborar conteúdos online;
Elaborar materiais didáticos seguindo orientações específicas.
Traduzir textos e frases do português para o inglês ou do inglês para o português com alto nível de precisão.
Revisar materiais didáticos de forma precisa, garantindo que esses estejam isentos de erros.
Corrigir exercícios e esclarecer dúvidas por meio eletrônico através de e-mail, chat, portal de estudos e redes sociais.
Fazer atendimentos de conversação individual e em grupo com alunos dentro do portal do aluno.
REQUISITOS:
Alto nível de conhecimento da língua inglesa em todas as habilidades (fala, entendimento, escrita e leitura).
Formação na área (cursos privados ou formação acadêmica).
Alto nível de conhecimento e domínio da língua portuguesa, principalmente da escrita.
(IMPORTANTE) Capacidade de traduzir frases e textos do inglês para o português com alto nível de precisão.
(IMPORTANTE) Disposição e abertura para estudo, testes, conhecimento e aplicação de metodologias de ensino diferentes das convencionais. Buscamos profissionais abertos à possibilidade de mudarem abordagens ou métodos em prol do uso de métodos mais modernos e eficientes.
Alto nível de disciplina e organização exigidos para o trabalho remoto.
Alto nível de atenção a detalhes.
Busca constante pela melhora e excelência tanto no trabalho em si quanto na produção das aulas e dos materiais didáticos.
Desejo de se estabelecer em uma empresa séria e crescer na carreira dentro da área de ensino de idiomas.
Domínio pleno do uso do computador, em especial programas como: Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, E-mail, ferramentas de comunicação e chat, etc.
Habilidades Pessoais
· Gostar de trabalhar em equipe.
· Ter proatividade e sugerir ideias, apresentar novos formatos e adaptar-se a novas plataformas.
· Ser flexível e mover-se com desenvoltura em ambientes de trabalho exigentes e em constante transformação.
· Ter uma atitude positiva.
· Comunicar-se com clareza e paixão, e transmitir isso às pessoas com quem trabalhe.
· Saber usar sua sensibilidade e bom senso.
O que lhe oferecemos?
· Trabalhar em uma das melhores empresas de ensino de idiomas online.
· Uma equipe criativa, dinâmica, colaborativa e multicultural.
· Um ambiente de trabalho ativo em que você pode aperfeiçoar suas habilidades, aprender ao lado de seus colegas e desenvolver sua carreira profissional.
· Um salário condizente com sua experiência e perfil.
Vale alimentação
Assistência médica

· Seu CV.
· Uma motivada carta de apresentação que explique por que você se considera a pessoa ideal para este cargo.

Marketing (Remote – EST Hours)
We're a B2 B data company that's been around for 15 years and quietly powers a lot of the world's best sales and recruiting tools. We don't do a lot of marketing — and that's exactly why this role exists.
We're looking for someone early in their career who has a lot to prove and wants to do it at a company where they'll actually get to own things. Not shadow someone. Not make decks. Actually own things.
This isn't a structured program with a defined path. It's closer to: here's the company, here's what we're trying to do, now help us grow. If that sounds exciting to you, read on.
What you'll work on
- Helping us figure out how to get more of the right people to discover Mix Rank — through content, SEO, paid, or whatever actually works
- Writing and producing content that speaks to our buyers (data teams, growth teams, Rev Ops, researchers)
- Running experiments, measuring what works, and doing more of it
- Working directly with the founder and team to sharpen how we talk about our product
What we're looking for
- 1–3 years of experience in any flavor of marketing — organic, paid, content, product marketing
- If social media management is the primary thing you've done, this probably isn't the right fit
- Strong writer. This one's non-negotiable.
- You work well without being told what to do every day
- Available during EST hours, comfortable working async and sync with a distributed team
- Early in your career and want to learn fast, not coast
Why join
Some of the best people at Mix Rank joined when they were just getting started. A few years in, they're running large chunks of the business. We hire for attitude and potential, and we give people real responsibility early.

title: Analista contábil fiscal jr.
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em um grupo eleito como a 86a startup mais promissora do Brasil?
A Conface Contabilidade, empresa da Dreamland Holding (que também inclui a Dream Success), está em busca de um(a) Analista Contábil Fiscal Jr. para integrar o time.
Essa é uma oportunidade para contadores que desejam crescer em uma contabilidade reconhecida pelo modelo inovador e por um atendimento verdadeiramente humanizado.
Para nós, contabilidade não é apenas enviar tributos para o cliente todos os meses. É fazer parte da vida do empreendedor, ajudando-o a crescer e tomar decisões estratégicas.
Responsabilidades (Fiscal & Contábil)
Apuração de impostos: ISS, ICMS, IPI, IRPJ, CSLL, PIS e COFINS.
Obrigações acessórias: EFD ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, ECD, ECF, DCTF, EFD-Reinf e DEFIS (e DIRF quando exigida pela legislação vigente).
Acompanhamento das mudanças do IVA (Imposto sobre Valor Adicionado) que passam a vigorar a partir do próximo ano.
Fechamento contábil autônomo: conciliações, provisões, classificação contábil, balancetes, Balanço e DRE.
Relatórios gerenciais e indicadores das empresas da carteira.
Atendimento consultivo a clientes para dúvidas técnicas (fiscal e contábil).
Demais atividades inerentes ao cargo. Requisitos
Graduação em Ciências Contábeis (concluída ou em andamento).
CRC ativo (obrigatório e deve constar no currículo enviado para conferência).
Experiência anterior na função fiscal/contábil em escritório de contabilidade.
Conhecimento de Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional.
Domínio do Pacote Office (principalmente Excel).
Sistema Domínio: conhecimento prático e comprovado (eliminatório).
Organização, atenção a detalhes, senso de dono e comunicação clara em ambiente remoto. Nossa cultura
Aqui, trabalho é esforço, resultado e entrega.
Valorizamos profissionais que desejam ter direitos respeitados, mas que também entendem que nossa empresa preza por meritocracia e comprometimento.
Não seguimos a chamada "cultura do mimimi".
Acreditamos em um ambiente justo, com reconhecimento proporcional ao desempenho, onde quem se dedica, cresce.
Benefícios
Vaga 100% remota — Acreditamos de verdade no Home Office. Mas com monitoramento de performance por metas e entregas claras. Utilizamos um programa chamado Jibble, para controle de trabalho remoto.
Gestão humanizada — Valorizamos a diversidade e quem você é. Para nós humanização começa com quem está aqui dentro.
Day-off no aniversário — Aproveite seu dia para comemorar.
Feedbacks trimestrais estruturados através do nosso Comitê de Pessoas — Significa que você tem chance real de ser promovido a cada 3 meses, conforme seu desempenho.
Caju Benefícios Flexíveis — Disponibilizamos R$600 por mês para você utilizar em benefícios flexíveis.
Rapidoc — Acesso ao maior hub de saúde corporativa digital do Brasil. Disponibilizamos para você e 3 familiares pago 100% pela nossa empresa.
Treinamento e desenvolvimento — Investimos no seu crescimento com cursos pagos pela empresa.
Adicional no salário caso utilize equipamentos próprios para trabalho remoto — Afinal respeitamos seus equipamentos próprios e vamos te pagar pela utilização dos mesmos, caso necessário. Como se candidatar
Candidate-se pelo Linked In e mantenha seu currículo atualizado, mandatóriamente em PDF.
É obrigatório que o número do CRC ativo conste no currículo para validação.
Caso possua, anexe certificações e destaque projetos/rotinas relevantes (fechamento contábil, ECD/ECF, apuração de tributos, acompanhamento de legislação e uso do Sistema Domínio).
Nosso processo seletivo será feito em 4 fases com previsão de contratação ainda neste mês de Abril/26. Venha construir sua carreira com a gente e fazer parte de um time que está transformando o futuro da contabilidade e das empresas!

title: Gtm builder
description:
GTM builder
You are an AI-native builder. You don't just use AI tools; you build agents, copilots, and autonomous systems. You understand how modern LLMs actually work: tool use, reasoning loops, structured outputs, retrieval, memory, and orchestration. You are comfortable vibe-coding, shipping fast, and learning new AI tooling weekly. You've built side projects, internal tools, or production systems using LLMs, agents, or automation frameworks. You think in systems, not scripts. You'll be responsible for building A...
You know that the leverage of a single great AI builder today is 10–100x a traditional engineer. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.
You Will:
• Design and deploy autonomous AI agents that can research, reason, and execute real business workflows
• Build agentic systems using modern LLM capabilities including tool use, function calling, structured outputs, and multi-step reasoning
• Create internal AI copilots used daily by marketing, sales and operations
• Implement retrieval systems (RAG) using embeddings and vector databases to give agents context and memory
• Build AI workflows that can enrich accounts, qualify leads, generate insights, and automate execution
• Integrate AI agents deeply into our stack: Hub Spot, internal databases, enrichment platforms, and product systems
• Automate workflows that previously required human operational effort
• Build scraping, parsing, and AI extraction systems to convert unstructured web data into structured intelligence
• Rapidly prototype, test, and deploy new AI capabilities as new models and tools become available
• Continuously improve agents to make them faster, smarter, cheaper, and more reliable
• Build reusable internal frameworks, tools, and agent architectures
• Own systems end-to-end — from idea to production
You Have:
• Strong software engineering ability and the ability to ship working systems quickly
• Hands-on experience building with modern LLMs and AI tools (Open AI, Anthropic, open models, or similar)
• Experience building AI agents, copilots, or automated workflows
• Strong prompt engineering skills and understanding of structured prompting and reliability
• Experience integrating APIs, webhooks, and external systems
• Ability to work with structured and unstructured data
• Experience with automation tools like N8 N, Make, Zapier, or similar
• Comfort working with web scraping, enrichment systems, and data pipelines
• Strong builder mindset — you learn fast, experiment fast, and ship fast
• High agency — you figure things out without needing step-by-step instructions
• Curiosity and obsession with new AI capabilities
• Bonus: Experience with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval systems
• Bonus: Experience building multi-step agent workflows
• Bonus: You actively build AI projects outside of work
• Bonus: You use AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow

title: Senior accountant
description:

Full Time
Remote
2.000 USD About Us:
We are a growth financing marketplace for small business owners, with a mission to increase access to entrepreneurship. By connecting businesses to growth capital and offering world-class financial management services, we empower entrepreneurs to take control of their financials and achieve sustainable economic success.

Tech-savvy with strong aptitude for learning new software, AI tools, and automation platforms
Experience with modern accounting tech stack beyond Quick Books (APIs, integrations, data analysis tools)
Comfortable working in an AI-driven, technology-first environment with rapid tool adoption
Client-facing experience with strong communication and presentation skills
Advanced proficiency in Quick Books Online and willingness to master emerging fintech solutions
Detail-oriented, hands on, accountable, and deadline-driven with daily bookkeeping activities, driving strategic financial analysis and strong sense of prioritization to meet deadlines.
Experienced with process improvement and system implementation
Strong analytical skill, confidently review financial data and turn it into clear, actionable insights.
Experienced in identifying discrepancies, spotting trends, and ensuring the accuracy of financial records.
Understanding of accounting-tax interdependencies and multi-state compliance requirements
Excited about leveraging technology to scale accounting operations and improve client outcomes
Advanced or native English proficiency Details
Full-time position (Remote – Colombia, Brasil, Guatemala) Exclusivity required — no simultaneous employment during agreed working hours.

title: Operations manager (marketing)
description:
About No Limit EmailNo Limit Email is a retention marketing agency helping US-based DTC and ecommerce brands unlock the full revenue potential of their existing customers.
We're not just an email agency — we're a retention agency.
We've helped 200+ brands generate over $80 M in email-attributed revenue, working with companies like Unilever, Carnivore Snax, Depology, and Raycon.
Our team of 15–20 operates globally, with leadership based in Bali. In 2024, we generated $1.8 M AUD in revenue with a 20% profit margin — and we're now building the operational backbone to scale significantly. The Role
We're hiring an Operations Manager to take how this agency runs day-to-day and make it tighter, faster, and more scalable — without sacrificing quality.
You will own the internal machine:
How work flows through the agency
How the team stays accountable
How clients are onboarded
How nothing falls through the cracks You'll work directly with the co-founders and play a key role in scaling the business.
This is not a passive " SOP-writing" role.
This is a hands-on leadership role focused on execution, systems, and impact. What You'll Own
Workflow & Project Management
Design and optimize end-to-end workflows (brief → QA → delivery → reporting)
Ensure clear ownership and accountability across all projects
Build QA systems to prevent costly errors
Manage team capacity and workload distribution Agency-Wide Planning & Alignment
Run quarterly planning (OKRs) with leadership
Align team execution with company goals
Track progress on revenue, retention, and operational efficiency Client Operations & Onboarding
Own onboarding from kickoff to system setup (including Klaviyo access)
Build structured brand documentation frameworks
Monitor account health and proactively flag risks Team Operations & Performance
Build systems for tracking performance and productivity
Support hiring, onboarding, and training
Create feedback loops to improve processes and reduce errors AI & Automation
Use AI tools (Claude, etc.) to streamline operations
Identify automation opportunities across workflows
Drive AI adoption across the team Financial & Resource Operations
Track profitability and resource allocation
Support forecasting and capacity planning
Monitor key operational KPIs (delivery speed, utilization, error rates) Requirements (Non-Negotiable)
5+ years as an Operations Manager (or similar) in a retention marketing agency (DTC/ecommerce clients)
Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or similar CRM platforms
Daily working overlap with Bali (GMT+8)
Proven experience using AI tools (Claude or similar) in operations Strongly Preferred
Shopify / DTC ecosystem experience
Experience managing remote teams across time zones
Experience with Click Up, Asana, or similar tools
Experience scaling agencies (15 → 40+ people) What We Offer
Competitive salary based on experience
Direct collaboration with founders
High-impact role in a scaling agency
Remote-first global team
Real growth opportunities as the company scales Next StepIf we move forward with your application, we will ask for:
Case studies or concrete examples of how you increased profit, reduced waste, or added measurable value in a previous Operations Manager role (preferably in a retention agency).
Numbers matter — show us impact, not just effort.

Collaborative, engineering-led product development process.

title: Digital marketing consultant
description:
Marketing (Remote – EST Hours)
We're a B2 B data company that's been around for 15 years and quietly powers a lot of the world's best sales and recruiting tools. We don't do a lot of marketing — and that's exactly why this role exists.
We're looking for someone early in their career who has a lot to prove and wants to do it at a company where they'll actually get to own things. Not shadow someone. Not make decks. Actually own things.
This isn't a structured program with a defined path. It's closer to: here's the company, here's what we're trying to do, now help us grow. If that sounds exciting to you, read on.
What you'll work on
- Helping us figure out how to get more of the right people to discover Mix Rank — through content, SEO, paid, or whatever actually works
- Writing and producing content that speaks to our buyers (data teams, growth teams, Rev Ops, researchers)
- Running experiments, measuring what works, and doing more of it
- Working directly with the founder and team to sharpen how we talk about our product
What we're looking for
- 1–3 years of experience in any flavor of marketing — organic, paid, content, product marketing
- If social media management is the primary thing you've done, this probably isn't the right fit
- Strong writer. This one's non-negotiable.
- You work well without being told what to do every day
- Available during EST hours, comfortable working async and sync with a distributed team
- Early in your career and want to learn fast, not coast
Why join
Some of the best people at Mix Rank joined when they were just getting started. A few years in, they're running large chunks of the business. We hire for attitude and potential, and we give people real responsibility early.

title: Gtm builder
description:
GTM builder
You are an AI-native builder. You don't just use AI tools; you build agents, copilots, and autonomous systems. You understand how modern LLMs actually work: tool use, reasoning loops, structured outputs, retrieval, memory, and orchestration. You are comfortable vibe-coding, shipping fast, and learning new AI tooling weekly. You've built side projects, internal tools, or production systems using LLMs, agents, or automation frameworks. You think in systems, not scripts. You'll be responsible for building A...
You know that the leverage of a single great AI builder today is 10–100x a traditional engineer. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.
You Will:
• Design and deploy autonomous AI agents that can research, reason, and execute real business workflows
• Build agentic systems using modern LLM capabilities including tool use, function calling, structured outputs, and multi-step reasoning
• Create internal AI copilots used daily by marketing, sales and operations
• Implement retrieval systems (RAG) using embeddings and vector databases to give agents context and memory
• Build AI workflows that can enrich accounts, qualify leads, generate insights, and automate execution
• Integrate AI agents deeply into our stack: Hub Spot, internal databases, enrichment platforms, and product systems
• Automate workflows that previously required human operational effort
• Build scraping, parsing, and AI extraction systems to convert unstructured web data into structured intelligence
• Rapidly prototype, test, and deploy new AI capabilities as new models and tools become available
• Continuously improve agents to make them faster, smarter, cheaper, and more reliable
• Build reusable internal frameworks, tools, and agent architectures
• Own systems end-to-end — from idea to production
You Have:
• Strong software engineering ability and the ability to ship working systems quickly
• Hands-on experience building with modern LLMs and AI tools (Open AI, Anthropic, open models, or similar)
• Experience building AI agents, copilots, or automated workflows
• Strong prompt engineering skills and understanding of structured prompting and reliability
• Experience integrating APIs, webhooks, and external systems
• Ability to work with structured and unstructured data
• Experience with automation tools like N8 N, Make, Zapier, or similar
• Comfort working with web scraping, enrichment systems, and data pipelines
• Strong builder mindset — you learn fast, experiment fast, and ship fast
• High agency — you figure things out without needing step-by-step instructions
• Curiosity and obsession with new AI capabilities
• Bonus: Experience with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval systems
• Bonus: Experience building multi-step agent workflows
• Bonus: You actively build AI projects outside of work
• Bonus: You use AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow

title: Senior customer success manager — google ads & linkedin ads
description:
Company: Scalix AI Location: Fully Remote Type: Full-time Reports to: Founder / CEO About Scalix AI
Scalix AI is a performance-focused Google Ads and Linked In Ads agency built on one principle: paid media should drive real business outcomes, not vanity metrics. Founded by a former 8-year Google veteran, we work with ambitious Saa S companies, B2 B brands, nonprofits, home services operators, and growth-stage businesses who expect more than dashboards — they expect partnership, strategy, and results.
We're small, sharp, and scaling. This role is central to how we grow. The Role
We're hiring a Senior Customer Success Manager who lives at the intersection of Google Ads expertise, Linked In Ads fluency, and high-trust client relationships. You'll own a book of business end-to-end — from kickoff through renewal — and be the strategic voice clients rely on when they want to know why the numbers are moving and what to do next.
This isn't a reporting role. This is a thinking-partner role. You'll build campaigns that actually ladder up to revenue, translate performance into narrative, and hold the line on strategy when clients push in unproductive directions. What You'll Own
Client relationships. You are the face of Scalix AI for your accounts. You lead weekly/bi-weekly calls, quarterly business reviews, and the hard conversations that come with managing paid media budgets.
Campaign strategy and execution. You build, optimize, and scale Google Ads (Search, PMax, Demand Gen, Display, You Tube) and Linked In Ads (Sponsored Content, Message Ads, Lead Gen Forms, ABM campaigns) across multiple verticals.
Storytelling through data. You turn performance data into a narrative the client's CEO, CMO, or founder actually wants to read. Numbers alone don't retain clients — meaning does.
Attribution and measurement. You set up clean measurement (GA4, Linked In Insight Tag, conversion APIs, offline conversion imports) and defend the integrity of attribution when the data gets messy.
Proactive optimization. You don't wait for the client to ask. You spot, flag, and fix.
Retention and expansion. You identify opportunities to expand scope and you catch churn signals before they become churn. What We're Looking ForRequired:
5–8 years of hands-on paid media experience, with meaningful time spent in both Google Ads and Linked In Ads (not just one with a side of the other)
Direct, in-platform experience with Fibbler
Proven track record managing client relationships as the primary point of contact — ideally in an agency or consultancy setting
Strong storytelling ability: you can write a QBR narrative, present on Zoom with confidence, and explain a CPA spike in a way that builds trust rather than erodes it
Deep technical fluency in campaign architecture, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, creative testing, and conversion tracking across both platforms
Comfort with attribution conversations — last-click vs. data-driven, view-through, offline conversion imports, CRM-integrated measurement
B2 B and Saa S paid media experience Bonus:
HVAC, home services, or nonprofit vertical experience
Familiarity with tools like Hub Spot, Salesforce, GA4, Looker Studio, Supermetrics, Hockey Stack, or similar
Linked In Marketing Labs certification and/or Google Ads certifications
Experience building SOPs, onboarding docs, or client-facing collateral Who Thrives Here
You treat client accounts like you own them, because at Scalix AI, you effectively do.
You have opinions and you can defend them — but you also know when to flex.
You're allergic to fluff. You'd rather say \"here's what's working, here's what isn't, here's what we're changing\" than hide behind a 40-slide deck.
You want to work on a team that moves fast, ships work, and treats paid media as a craft — not a commodity. What We Offer
Fully remote — work from anywhere that overlaps reasonably with North American client hours
Direct access to the founder and real input on how the agency is built
A portfolio of clients who actually want to be partnered with (we screen hard at the front door)
Room to grow into team leadership as we scale How to ApplySend us:
A short note on the most interesting paid media problem you've solved in the last 12 months — across either Google or Linked In
Your resume or Linked In profile
One QBR, case study, or client-facing deliverable you're proud of (redact as needed) We read everything. We respond to everyone who takes the time to apply thoughtfully.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Na Ligia Academy, estamos buscando um/a Professor/a de Inglês
Hoje um de nossos projetos o Francês com a Ligia é hoje uma referência no ensino do idioma francês online no Brasil. Ela nasceu pequena, porém hoje, milhares de alunos já conseguiram realizar o sonho de falar francês.
E vem mais por ai!
Neste momento vivemos um momento incrível de expansão, no qual estamos ampliando nossa produção de conteúdo e de ensino do inglês, por isso estamos construindo uma nova equipe responsável por representar este novo momento.
O que faz um/a Professor/a de Inglês no Francês com a Ligia?
Baseado em nosso método de ensino (Método Francês com a Ligia) e tudo o que ele propõe, o candidato/a deverá:

Alto nível de conhecimento da língua inglesa em todas as habilidades (fala, entendimento, escrita e leitura).

Alto nível de conhecimento e domínio da língua portuguesa, principalmente da escrita.

Busca constante pela melhora e excelência tanto no trabalho em si quanto na produção das aulas e dos materiais didáticos.
Desejo de se estabelecer em uma empresa séria e crescer na carreira dentro da área de ensino de idiomas.

title: Cobol developer (as400)
description:
Company Description
Findmore Consulting S. A. specializes in Information Technologies and process excellence, including professional services, nearshoring, software development, UX/UI design, and agility. Since 2006, the company has contributed to major projects across Portugal and Europe, growing to employ over 500 professionals and achieving annual revenue exceeding 40 million euros. Recognized as one of the best SMEs in Portugal, Findmore has been honored in Deloitte's \"Technology Fast 500 TM\" ranking for its innovation and rapid growth in the EMEA region. The company provides continuous learning opportunities through the Findmore Academy and is a Premium Selected Partner of Software AG in Portugal, Angola, and the UAE.
Role Description
This is a full-time remote position for a Cobol Developer (AS400) at Findmore Consulting, S. A. The role involves creating, maintaining, and enhancing applications on AS400 systems using COBOL. The selected candidate will analyze system requirements, collaborate with teams to design efficient technical solutions, write and debug code, and perform testing to ensure software quality and performance. Additionally, the developer will support business-critical processes, ensure system integrations are optimized, and maintain technical documentation.
Qualifications
Strong Programming and Mainframe skills, with expertise in COBOL development and familiarity with AS400 systems
Knowledge of databases such as SQL Server, DB2, or Elastic
Knowledge of microservices architecture
Experience with APIs (REST and SOAP)
Proficiency in Systems Analysis and the ability to design and implement efficient technical solutions
Experience in Software Development, including code debugging, testing, and documentation
Excellent Analytical Skills, with the capacity to identify issues and implement effective solutions
Ability to work independently in a remote environment and communicate effectively within diverse teams
Strong problem-solving and organizational skills
Previous experience in the financial, banking, or insurance sector is an advantage
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred

title: Gerente de marketing digital
description:
Localização: Remoto
Tipo de contratação: Tempo integral
Sobre a posição
Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Marketing Digital para atuar na coordenação e evolução das iniciativas de marketing em canais digitais.
Esta função é ideal para profissionais com experiência em marketing digital que buscam atuar em um ambiente estruturado, com foco em planejamento, execução consistente e análise de resultados. O papel envolve trabalhar em conjunto com diferentes áreas para garantir que as iniciativas de marketing estejam alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio.
O que você irá fazer
Liderar e coordenar iniciativas de marketing digital em diferentes canais.
Acompanhar o desempenho das campanhas e garantir o monitoramento de indicadores relevantes.
Organizar fluxos de trabalho e alinhar atividades entre equipes internas.
Analisar dados de performance para apoiar decisões e melhorias contínuas.
Apoiar na estruturação de relatórios e acompanhamento de resultados.
Garantir consistência na execução das iniciativas e alinhamento com processos internos.
Contribuir para a evolução das práticas e rotinas de marketing.
O que esperamos de você
Experiência em marketing digital ou áreas relacionadas.
Familiaridade com canais digitais e estrutura de campanhas.
Perfil analítico e capacidade de trabalhar com dados.
Boa organização e habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas prioridades.
Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe.
Interesse em melhoria contínua e otimização de processos.
Ambiente de trabalho
Modelo remoto.
Estrutura de trabalho organizada e processos definidos.
Ambiente colaborativo, profissional e orientado a resultados.

title: Operations manager (marketing)
description:
About No Limit EmailNo Limit Email is a retention marketing agency helping US-based DTC and ecommerce brands unlock the full revenue potential of their existing customers.
We're not just an email agency — we're a retention agency.
We've helped 200+ brands generate over $80 M in email-attributed revenue, working with companies like Unilever, Carnivore Snax, Depology, and Raycon.
Our team of 15–20 operates globally, with leadership based in Bali. In 2024, we generated $1.8 M AUD in revenue with a 20% profit margin — and we're now building the operational backbone to scale significantly. The Role
We're hiring an Operations Manager to take how this agency runs day-to-day and make it tighter, faster, and more scalable — without sacrificing quality.
You will own the internal machine:
How work flows through the agency
How the team stays accountable
How clients are onboarded
How nothing falls through the cracks You'll work directly with the co-founders and play a key role in scaling the business.
This is not a passive " SOP-writing" role.
This is a hands-on leadership role focused on execution, systems, and impact. What You'll Own
Workflow & Project Management
Design and optimize end-to-end workflows (brief → QA → delivery → reporting)
Ensure clear ownership and accountability across all projects
Build QA systems to prevent costly errors
Manage team capacity and workload distribution Agency-Wide Planning & Alignment
Run quarterly planning (OKRs) with leadership
Align team execution with company goals
Track progress on revenue, retention, and operational efficiency Client Operations & Onboarding
Own onboarding from kickoff to system setup (including Klaviyo access)
Build structured brand documentation frameworks
Monitor account health and proactively flag risks Team Operations & Performance
Build systems for tracking performance and productivity
Support hiring, onboarding, and training
Create feedback loops to improve processes and reduce errors AI & Automation
Use AI tools (Claude, etc.) to streamline operations
Identify automation opportunities across workflows
Drive AI adoption across the team Financial & Resource Operations
Track profitability and resource allocation
Support forecasting and capacity planning
Monitor key operational KPIs (delivery speed, utilization, error rates) Requirements (Non-Negotiable)
5+ years as an Operations Manager (or similar) in a retention marketing agency (DTC/ecommerce clients)
Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or similar CRM platforms
Daily working overlap with Bali (GMT+8)
Proven experience using AI tools (Claude or similar) in operations Strongly Preferred
Shopify / DTC ecosystem experience
Experience managing remote teams across time zones
Experience with Click Up, Asana, or similar tools
Experience scaling agencies (15 → 40+ people) What We Offer
Competitive salary based on experience
Direct collaboration with founders
High-impact role in a scaling agency
Remote-first global team
Real growth opportunities as the company scales Next StepIf we move forward with your application, we will ask for:
Case studies or concrete examples of how you increased profit, reduced waste, or added measurable value in a previous Operations Manager role (preferably in a retention agency).
Numbers matter — show us impact, not just effort.

title: Paid media specialist
description:
Remote Paid Media Specialist
Location: Remote from Latin America
Position Type: Full-time | Contractor Position
Salary: $1800 - $2500 USD per month via WISE or DEEL
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm ET or 9:00am - 6:00pm ET with a 1-hour lunch each day.
Our Client:
Our client, a Google Premier Partner and top 3% U. S. marketing agency, creates tools, digital campaigns, and events that enable businesses to maximize sales. They are seeking a Paid Media Specialist to join their team. They are seeking a professional who listens intently, concepts quickly, creates with a purpose, executes with thoroughness, and analyzes data like a scholar.
Are you passionate about marketing and want to learn from an expert team of digital marketers focused on results? Do you want to join a fast-growing digital media team? If you answered yes, then continue reading!
Responsibilities:
Campaign Setup and Maintenance: Assist with the setup, monitoring, and maintenance of digital marketing campaigns across various platforms (Google Ads, Meta, etc.). Ensure accurate implementation of tracking, targeting, and ad creative.
Data Entry and Reporting Support: Collect and organize campaign data for internal reporting. Help prepare performance summaries and dashboards for senior team members and account managers.
Quality Assurance: Perform basic QA tasks, including checking live ads, verifying proper tracking, and reviewing campaign components to ensure accuracy before launch.
Internal Collaboration: Support account coordinators and managers by completing assigned backend tasks accurately and on time. Communicate any roadblocks or questions clearly and proactively.
Documentation and Process Adherence: Follow internal processes and documentation standards to maintain campaign consistency and quality. Help keep internal records organized and up to date.
Growth Mindset: Stay curious and eager to learn about trends, technologies, and best practices in digital marketing. Take initiative in growing your skills through hands-on experience and feedback. Qualifications, Skills and Key Competencies:
Must Have Qualifications:
2+ years of Google & Meta Ads experience
Managed ad spends in the thousands ($1,500/month+)
Google Ads Certifications: Paid Search, Display, Video, Shopping & Performance. Qualifications which will set you apart:
Google Tag Manager experience
Microsoft Ads experience
Google Analytics experience
Experience using data visualization tools such as: Power BI, Tableau, Google Data Studio (Looker Studio) & Tap Clicks
Experience in a deadline-driven environment
Strong analytical thinker, driven problem solver, and a curiosity to understand the why as well as the what.
Experience exceeding expectations.
Excellent English level both written and spoken
